title: Operating-model policy (.foundry/operating-model.yaml)
description: The factory governance kit's policy surface. Absent file = every default. A FLOOR key is a `const`: it can be written only as its enforced value, and any other value fails validation with `floor-rule-disabled:<key>`. A TUNABLE key carries a `default`. `additionalProperties: false` at every level, so a typo is a named error.

queue.description: auto = detect from the live ruleset.

requeue_budget_outside_diff.description: FLOOR (A2): exactly one re-queue for a failure outside the diff; never a third roll.

record_line_before_enqueue.description: FLOOR (A2): the one-line record before each enqueue.

human_review_required.description: A4 tunable; agent review is the floor.

heavy_slots.description: B2 tunable size; auto = from measured CPU and memory.

resource_check.description: FLOOR (B2): measure the machine every tick.

workflow_size_source.description: FLOOR (B8): the smaller of the session setting and the tick prompt wins.

research_first.description: FLOOR (B3): research answers questions before the operator is asked.

escalation_set.description: The only reasons to ask the operator.

expires_after.description: Lease lifetime without a heartbeat (m, h or d).

weigh_in_every_decision.description: FLOOR (C1): cost is a decision input.

priced_ask_for_always_on.description: FLOOR (C1): a new always-on resource needs a priced ask.

handoff_dir.description: E3 tunable; the placeholder is filled by the operator.

style.description: E2 tunable, default on. Unquoted YAML off, no and false are accepted aliases for the word off.

operator_style_file.description: A regular .md or .txt file under .foundry/ (no dot-file, no symlink, at most 4 KiB), used when style is operator-defined. Its text is operator instruction text by design.

builder.description: B7 tunable: the model for builders. smaller = the smaller model.

reviewer.description: B7 tunable: the model for separate-context reviewers. Reviewers get a diff file, never shell access.

security_reviewer.description: B7 tunable: the model for security reviews of auth, secrets and crypto. strongest = the strongest model.

teardown_required.description: FLOOR (F1): pair every start with a teardown.

value_reads_forbidden.description: FLOOR (D1): never read a secret value.

forbidden_verbs.description: D1 ADD-ONLY: extra command phrases the secret-read guard refuses (the command word, then sub-words in order, e.g. `aws iam create-login-profile`). Merged OVER the built-in defaults, which can never be removed: an item that starts with `!` or `-`, or a mapping with `remove`, fails validation with `floor-rule-disabled:secrets.forbidden_verbs.removal`.

no_print_roots.description: D1 ADD-ONLY: extra paths (a directory prefix such as `~/.config/op`, or a basename glob such as `*.pem`) that no reader command may be pointed at. Merged OVER the built-in roots (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.kube, .env*), which can never be removed; a removal marker fails with `floor-rule-disabled:secrets.no_print_roots.removal`.

chat_mirror.description: Opt-in; PROD-BEFORE and PROD-AFTER only. Unquoted YAML off/no/false mean off and on/yes/true mean on.

cleanup_timeout_s.description: Total wait for the --on-failure cleanup commands of foundry_prod_step.py before it posts STOP with 'cleanup timed out'.

size_tag_required.description: A design is required at or above this size tag.
